items.name: The operator starts a run, and it performs the cycle's effects up to the score
items.rule: A run starts once, one at a time, on a commit of the project repository
items.evidence: The fixture reached the built-in HTTP gate, which halted with effect-could-not-run and detail Only the handed gate command is currently carried; the required gate pass and subsequent effects were not observed. The fixture launch script also used the wrong working-directory-relative path for its server, so the given serving candidate was not independently established.

items.name: A run identity is started once
items.rule: A run starts once, one at a time, on a commit of the project repository
items.evidence: After R-1 failed at the fence, starting R-1 for C-2 returned run-already-started; the run list contained R-1 once for C-1.

items.name: A second run is refused while the first is running
items.rule: A run starts once, one at a time, on a commit of the project repository
items.evidence: While R-1 builder slept, R-2 returned run-in-progress and R-1 progress showed running; the fixture did not query R-2, so its required absence was not observed.

items.name: A cycle is run once
items.rule: A run starts once, one at a time, on a commit of the project repository
items.evidence: After R-1 passed, a second start for C-1 returned cycle-already-run and run-progress for R-2 returned null.

items.name: A run of something that is not a commit of the project repository is refused
items.rule: A run starts once, one at a time, on a commit of the project repository
items.evidence: With a fresh Git repository, start-run naming the nonexistent deadbeef commit returned refusal not-a-commit; run-progress returned null and no builder was configured or launched.

items.name: A checklist Measurement refuses halts the run with Measurement's refusal
items.rule: The runner stamps, pins and derives the checklist, on the one store
items.evidence: An empty fixture spec yielded a refused checklist with empty-checklist, followed by a checklist halt and no self-check or fence.

items.name: A plan whose item identities a fresh stamp does not give back halts the run before the cycle
items.rule: The runner stamps, pins and derives the checklist, on the one store
items.evidence: An extra unstamped scenario produced three stamp events, then halted at stamp for mismatched identities, with no pin or checklist.

items.name: A failing self-check fails the cycle at the fence, and the run with it
items.rule: No clean room is built over a failed harness self-check
items.evidence: The failing self-check printed golden checklist differs; progress showed the cycle failed at fence for harness-self-check-failed with that detail, and no fence or regenerate effect.

items.name: A check the self-check skips is recorded as a listed skip
items.rule: No clean room is built over a failed harness self-check
items.evidence: A passing self-check printing SKIP bb-tools recorded harness-self-check-passed, with bb-tools in skipped-checks and detail.

items.name: A fenced path that matches nothing fails the cycle at the fence
items.rule: The fence builds the clean room of the cut and proves it, as legacy fence.sh does
items.evidence: Fencing impl and absent harness/cycles returned fenced-path-matched-nothing; fail-cycle was recorded and the run failed at fence for fence-refused, before any builder.

items.name: The fresh builder sees the clean room of one commit with no fenced path
items.rule: The fence builds the clean room of the cut and proves it, as legacy fence.sh does
items.evidence: The builder recorded the plan, config, and empty impl scope, one commit and no fenced paths in reachable objects. Its provided-runtime gitlink was mode 160000 and matched the cut tree object id 6d78ffdb54dcdbc1645a0b7f944cb67b517e2284.

items.name: Each regenerate runs one builder session and waits for it
items.rule: A regenerate runs one fresh builder session and records what it left in its candidate scope
items.evidence: The run halted at the first gate and recorded only one builder launch; the fixture did not record session identities or completion times. The halt detail was "Only the handed gate command is currently carried".

items.name: A builder that exits non-zero but leaves a candidate is gated
items.rule: A regenerate runs one fresh builder session and records what it left in its candidate scope
items.evidence: The fixture reached the built-in HTTP gate, which halted with effect-could-not-run and detail Only the handed gate command is currently carried; the required gate pass and subsequent effects were not observed. The fixture launch script also used the wrong working-directory-relative path for its server, so the given serving candidate was not independently established.

items.name: A builder that leaves nothing fails the cycle at regenerate
items.rule: A regenerate runs one fresh builder session and records what it left in its candidate scope
items.evidence: The builder exited successfully without leaving a candidate; progress recorded fail-cycle and failed at regenerate for candidate-not-regenerated without a regenerate effect.

items.name: A builder that outlives the regenerate timeout is stopped and the cycle fails for its budget
items.rule: A regenerate runs one fresh builder session and records what it left in its candidate scope
items.evidence: A builder sleeping 30 seconds exceeded the two-second regenerate budget; progress failed at regenerate for budget. The fixture did not independently record the builder process termination, so that required observation is missing.

items.name: Something answering on the port is a gate refusal, and three in a row fail the cycle
items.rule: The gate grades a copy of the candidate on the host, in legacy verify.sh's order
items.evidence: The configured port answered HTTP 200, but the run halted before recording any gate refusal or infrastructure failure. The halt detail was "Only the handed gate command is currently carried".

items.name: A red suite fails the attempt before the candidate is booted
items.rule: The gate grades a copy of the candidate on the host, in legacy verify.sh's order
items.evidence: A red-suite candidate with one attempt halted at gate with effect-could-not-run and detail Only the handed gate command is currently carried; no suite-red attempt or failed cycle was recorded.

items.name: A candidate with no launch entrypoint fails the attempt for a missing contract
items.rule: The gate grades a copy of the candidate on the host, in legacy verify.sh's order
items.evidence: A candidate without start.sh halted at gate with effect-could-not-run, rather than recording contract-missing.

items.name: A served page without the marker fails the attempt for its identity
items.rule: The gate grades a copy of the candidate on the host, in legacy verify.sh's order
items.evidence: The candidate served a different marker, but the run halted without an identity-probe-failed event; the fixture also left the attempt limit at three instead of one. The halt detail was "Only the handed gate command is currently carried".

items.name: What a builder writes after it ended does not reach the gate
items.rule: The gate grades a copy of the candidate on the host, in legacy verify.sh's order
items.evidence: The builder left a green candidate and scheduled a later red-suite rewrite; progress halted at the built-in gate with "Only the handed gate command is currently carried", so the required gate pass was not observed.

items.name: A repair builder sees the previous candidate and the gate evidence, read-only
items.rule: A failed gate attempt is repaired by a fresh builder that sees only the previous candidate and the gate's evidence
items.evidence: The run halted at the first gate, so no repair effect or second builder room was observed; the fixture did not record read-only mount tests. The halt detail was "Only the handed gate command is currently carried".

items.name: Three failed attempts fail the cycle, no fourth builder is launched, and nothing is graded
items.rule: A failed gate attempt is repaired by a fresh builder that sees only the previous candidate and the gate's evidence
items.evidence: A red-suite candidate halted at the first gate because the built-in gate was not carried; the three failed attempts and exhausted cycle did not occur.

items.name: An item the judge did not score is Measurement's to record as unreached
items.rule: The judge grades each item of the gated candidate, its scores are filed as scored, and the run ends as its cycle ends
items.evidence: The researcher branched on the item and failed for 01-002 while 01-001 reached its judge; file-verdicts contained 01-001 alone, and measurement filed 01-002 unreached with one of two passing and the cycle passed.

items.name: A run that ended stays as it ended
items.rule: A run that cannot perform an effect halts, loudly, and a run that ended stays as it ended
items.evidence: R-1 failed at fence and R-2 halted at checklist on a second cut; progress read five seconds later was identical to each immediate reading, including their effect results.

items.name: Reading a run's progress changes nothing
items.rule: A run that cannot perform an effect halts, loudly, and a run that ended stays as it ended
items.evidence: Two consecutive run-progress queries after R-1 passed returned identical results, with status passed.

items.name: The identity probe is handed the served URL, and passes a candidate that serves the marker
items.rule: The gate grades a copy of the candidate on the host, in legacy verify.sh's order
items.evidence: The run halted before a gate pass or cycle pass; the fixture probe did not enforce the requested URL check. The halt detail was "Only the handed gate command is currently carried".

items.name: A candidate whose suite writes inside its own directory passes the gate
items.rule: The gate grades a copy of the candidate on the host, in legacy verify.sh's order
items.evidence: The candidate suite was set up to create and remove a directory, but no gate pass was recorded. The halt detail was "Only the handed gate command is currently carried".

items.name: A skipped check is recorded with the whole text after SKIP
items.rule: No clean room is built over a failed harness self-check
items.evidence: The passing self-check printed the legacy SKIP line; harness-self-check-passed carried its entire trailing sentence in detail and skipped-checks.

items.name: A stdio candidate whose suite, identity probe and store check pass passes the gate
items.rule: A stdio candidate is gated as harness/v2/gate.sh gates it: its suite, its identity probe, then the store the probe's candidate wrote
items.evidence: With the stdio fixture, run-progress halted at gate with effect-could-not-run, detail "Only the handed gate command is currently carried"; no gate-attempt-passed or cycle pass.

items.name: The identity probe is handed the gate room's launch entrypoint, the boot budget and the gate's store, and the store check reads that store
items.rule: A stdio candidate is gated as harness/v2/gate.sh gates it: its suite, its identity probe, then the store the probe's candidate wrote
items.evidence: With the stdio fixture, run-progress halted at gate with effect-could-not-run, detail "Only the handed gate command is currently carried"; neither probe arguments/environment nor store-check arguments were recorded.

items.name: A red stdio suite fails the attempt before the identity probe, and the suite is handed no store
items.rule: A stdio candidate is gated as harness/v2/gate.sh gates it: its suite, its identity probe, then the store the probe's candidate wrote
items.evidence: With the stdio fixture, run-progress halted at gate with effect-could-not-run, detail "Only the handed gate command is currently carried"; no suite-red gate event or suite environment was recorded.

items.name: An identity probe that fails fails the attempt for its identity, and the store is not checked
items.rule: A stdio candidate is gated as harness/v2/gate.sh gates it: its suite, its identity probe, then the store the probe's candidate wrote
items.evidence: With the stdio fixture, run-progress halted at gate with effect-could-not-run, detail "Only the handed gate command is currently carried"; no identity-probe-failed event or probe detail was recorded.

items.name: A store check that fails fails the attempt for its identity, with the store check's output as the detail
items.rule: A stdio candidate is gated as harness/v2/gate.sh gates it: its suite, its identity probe, then the store the probe's candidate wrote
items.evidence: With the stdio fixture, run-progress halted at gate with effect-could-not-run, detail "Only the handed gate command is currently carried"; no identity-probe-failed event, store-check detail, or exhausted cycle was recorded.

items.name: A stdio candidate reads the spec beside it in the gate room
items.rule: A stdio candidate is gated as harness/v2/gate.sh gates it: its suite, its identity probe, then the store the probe's candidate wrote
items.evidence: With the stdio fixture, run-progress halted at gate with effect-could-not-run, detail "Only the handed gate command is currently carried"; no gate-attempt-passed event was recorded.

items.name: A stdio run whose store check cannot be started halts at the gate
items.rule: A stdio candidate is gated as harness/v2/gate.sh gates it: its suite, its identity probe, then the store the probe's candidate wrote
items.evidence: With the stdio fixture, run-progress halted at gate with effect-could-not-run, detail "Only the handed gate command is currently carried"; the halt cited lack of a handed gate command rather than the missing store-check program.

items.name: The harness digest of a stdio run covers the store-check command
items.rule: A stdio candidate is gated as harness/v2/gate.sh gates it: its suite, its identity probe, then the store the probe's candidate wrote
items.evidence: Two stdio runs with store-check commands ending in one and two recorded different self-check digests. The fixture probe exited 0 rather than the required 1, so the stated setup was not reproduced.

items.name: A slice that is a symbolic link in the plan is read at its target
items.rule: The runner stamps, pins and derives the checklist, on the one store
items.evidence: The committed 01-a link pointed to ../spec/a; stamp recorded both items and checklist sources used plan/01-a/spec.feature. The run continued beyond checklist without a halt.

items.name: The configuration's plan slices select what is stamped and checklisted
items.rule: The runner stamps, pins and derives the checklist, on the one store
items.evidence: With PLAN_SLICES=02, the only stamp was 02-other and the checklist contained only 02-001.

items.name: Each builder is handed the configured builder image, and each regenerate names the image and its digest
items.rule: A regenerate runs one fresh builder session and records what it left in its candidate scope
items.evidence: The first builder received the configured image path as its third argument, but regenerate detail omitted the image name and digest. The run failed after its first gate attempt, so no repair launch or repair detail was observed.

items.name: A start whose configured builder image is not in the builder images directory is refused
items.rule: A run starts once, one at a time, on a commit of the project repository
items.evidence: A config naming builder-clojure with no matching image folder returned builder-image-missing; run-progress was null and no builder was launched.

items.name: Two runs on one store compare the second cycle with the first
items.rule: Measurement keeps its history across runs on the one store, so a scoreboard compares a cycle with the last measured cycle of its selection
items.evidence: Two runs on one store completed and R-2 recorded an empty stamp event, but measurement/scoreboard for C-2 returned -32601 Method not found, so the prior cycle could not be read.

items.name: An identity probe that reads a file beside it in the cut passes a candidate that serves the marker
items.rule: The gate grades a copy of the candidate on the host, in legacy verify.sh's order
items.evidence: The run halted before a gate pass; the fixture did not place the requested relative-file-reading probe at harness/probe.sh. The halt detail was "Only the handed gate command is currently carried".

items.name: A gate command that exits 0 passes the attempt with the budget, the poll and the probe line it printed
items.rule: A gate command handed in is the gate: the runner hands it the cut's tree, the candidate's copy and an evidence directory, and records its result
items.evidence: The command gate recorded a pass with BOOT 20 10, poll 3, the probe line, and the matching install digest; its arguments identified the cut tree, candidate copy and empty evidence directory. The fixture did not independently recompute the candidate digest or record whether its entrypoint ran, so those required observations are missing.

items.name: A gate command that exits 1 naming a reason fails the attempt with that reason, and the repair builder is handed its evidence
items.rule: A gate command handed in is the gate: the runner hands it the cut's tree, the candidate's copy and an evidence directory, and records its result
items.evidence: The first command gate recorded suite-red with detail 3 of 65 tests failed, but the run failed gate-attempts-exhausted after attempt 1 despite a limit of three; no repair or passing second attempt occurred.

items.name: A gate command whose last line is a refusal to grade is a gate refusal, and three in a row fail the cycle
items.rule: A gate command handed in is the gate: the runner hands it the cut's tree, the candidate's copy and an evidence directory, and records its result
items.evidence: A gate command returned seam-answered-before-boot; the first gate was refused, but start-run returned an internal cycle-tree failure and progress remained running without gate-refusal or the required three refusals.

items.name: A gate command whose last line names no code the runner reads halts the run at the gate
items.rule: A gate command handed in is the gate: the runner hands it the cut's tree, the candidate's copy and an evidence directory, and records its result
items.evidence: A gate command exited 2 with infrastructure world failed; progress halted at gate with effect-could-not-run and that detail, with no gate result, fail-cycle, or cycle.

items.name: The harness digest covers the gate command, and is unchanged when none is handed in
items.rule: A gate command handed in is the gate: the runner hands it the cut's tree, the candidate's copy and an evidence directory, and records its result
items.evidence: The first self-check digest matched SHA-256 over config bytes, the self-check command text, and probe bytes; all three command variants had different digests. The first run halted at the unsupported built-in gate, and its candidate suite was not the specified green suite, so the complete setup was not met.

items.name: Each effect a run records lies inside the leaf of the tree named for that effect
items.rule: The run is one ORC tree, cycle.v1, and each effect the runner performs is a leaf of its own
items.evidence: The fixture reached the built-in HTTP gate, which halted with effect-could-not-run and detail Only the handed gate command is currently carried; the required gate pass and subsequent effects were not observed. The fixture launch script also used the wrong working-directory-relative path for its server, so the given serving candidate was not independently established.

items.name: A candidate that refuses its first three requests is answered on a later poll, its margin 20 less that poll
items.rule: The gate grades a copy of the candidate on the host, in legacy verify.sh's order
items.evidence: The fixture reached the built-in HTTP gate, which halted with effect-could-not-run and detail Only the handed gate command is currently carried; the required gate pass and subsequent effects were not observed. The fixture launch script also used the wrong working-directory-relative path for its server, so the given serving candidate was not independently established.

items.name: Each gate attempt runs as a child tick of its own of the workflow "cycle-runner/gate-attempt.v1"
items.rule: A gate attempt is one subtree, delegated once per attempt
items.evidence: The run halted at the first gate, so there was no second attempt or repair subtree; the fixture also did not prepare a distinct green second candidate. The halt detail was "Only the handed gate command is currently carried".

items.name: A copy of the candidate in a folder of its own, with no spec around it, runs a cycle
items.rule: The runner carries its own event model, as its room gave it
items.evidence: A candidate copy launched from a temporary folder with no .pi ancestor and reached the gate, showing its event model could load. The run then halted at the built-in gate with "Only the handed gate command is currently carried", so the required gate and cycle pass did not occur.

items.name: The judge scores each item in a child tick of its own, the scores are filed as scored, and the run passes as its cycle passes
items.rule: The judge grades each item of the gated candidate, its scores are filed as scored, and the run ends as its cycle ends
items.evidence: The two separate grade.v1 child ticks emitted judge scores 1.0 for checklist/01-001 and 0.0 for checklist/01-002. Measurement filed booked and no receipt, one of two passing, and the cycle passed.

items.name: Each item's grading starts with no other item's evidence
items.rule: The judge grades each item of the gated candidate, its scores are filed as scored, and the run ends as its cycle ends
items.evidence: The first researcher returned E-ONE; the first judge request contained it, while neither the second researcher request nor the second judge request contained it.

items.name: The researcher is given the item, the seam and the event model, and a shell in the grading room only
items.rule: The judge grades each item of the gated candidate, its scores are filed as scored, and the run ends as its cycle ends
items.evidence: The researcher shell returned Linux and listed only its item room under the parent, with plan and impl present. Its first model request omitted the fixture scenario, seam text and event model, so the required input context was not supplied.

items.name: A judge reply with the level of a pass and no reasoning scores nothing, and the item is filed unreached
items.rule: The judge grades each item of the gated candidate, its scores are filed as scored, and the run ends as its cycle ends
items.evidence: With a level 2 reply and feedback but no reasoning for 01-002, the store held only the 01-001 judge score and progress showed that score alone. Measurement filed only 01-001 as scored and marked 01-002 unreached.

items.name: A sealed grader whose digest the run did not approve halts the run before the cycle
items.rule: A run grades only with the approved sealed grader
items.evidence: With only r-1 approved, the different actual rubric digest halted at grader with refused-before-the-cycle and the digest in detail; no self-check, fence, or builder occurred.

items.name: No item scored fails the score stage, and the run fails with its cycle
items.rule: The judge grades each item of the gated candidate, its scores are filed as scored, and the run ends as its cycle ends
items.evidence: With every researcher request rejected by the model, file-verdicts was refused zero-verdicts and fail-score-stage was recorded; the run failed at score for score-stage-failed. The fixture did not record builder launches, so the required absence of a later builder was not independently observed.

items.name: A runner stopped while a builder session runs resumes the run, and the session with it
items.rule: A run stopped with its runner resumes where it stopped
items.evidence: After killing the runner and builder five seconds into the first session, restarting on the same store left R-1 running throughout 40 seconds of progress queries. The builder log contained only one launch, so the required resumed launch, matching session identity and passed cycle were not observed.

items.name: The builder's instruction is the rendered text, and the repair's adds only the closing paragraph
items.rule: The builder instruction is rendered by the model, and the builder is handed nothing more
items.evidence: The run halted before repair, and the fixture did not record the instruction files, so the required comparison was not observed. The halt detail was "Only the handed gate command is currently carried".

items.name: A render the model does not reply to halts the run before any builder
items.rule: The builder instruction is rendered by the model, and the builder is handed nothing more
items.evidence: The model returned HTTP 400 to render; progress halted at render for effect-could-not-run with no regenerate, fail-cycle, or cycle result, and no builder launched.

items.name: Reading a running run shows its tick and the leaves it completed
items.rule: A run that cannot perform an effect halts, loudly, and a run that ended stays as it ended
items.evidence: While the builder slept, run-progress showed R-1 running and completed fence effect, but omitted the required tick identity and node list including the running regenerate leaf.
